Subject: It's been a while — here's 20% off to get back out there
Preview: Your next trip is closer than you think. Offer ends Sunday.
Body: Hey,

We noticed it's been a bit since you last visited Northbay Supply. That happens — life gets in the way of the trail sometimes.

When you're ready to plan your next outing, we'd like to help. Take 20% off your next order through Sunday. No minimum, no hoops.

Head back to the site, pick what your next trip actually needs, and get moving.

Offer ends Sunday.
